package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestMigration025OnboardingPathAdmissionFencesAndPreservesEvidence(t *testing.T) {
	up, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/025_student_onboarding_path_admission.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	migration := string(up)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"BEGIN;", "COMMIT;", "student_onboarding_path_admission", "student_onboarding_path_admission_operation",
		"handoff_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE", "execution_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE", "uq_student_onboarding_path_admission_live",
		"status IN ('RESERVED','MATERIALIZED','ABORTED')", "student_onboarding_path_admission_update_guard",
		"BEFORE DELETE", "BEFORE TRUNCATE", "operation_kind IN ('RESERVE','RENEW','MATERIALIZE','ABORT')",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(migration, required) {
			t.Fatalf("migration missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	for _, required := range []string{
		"NEW.fence = OLD.fence + 1", "NEW.expires_at > OLD.expires_at",
		"NEW.status = 'MATERIALIZED' AND NEW.fence = OLD.fence AND NEW.expires_at = OLD.expires_at",
		"NEW.status = 'ABORTED' AND NEW.fence = OLD.fence AND NEW.expires_at = OLD.expires_at",
		"NEW.materialization_hash IS NOT NULL", "NEW.abort_hash IS NOT NULL",
		"materialization_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'", "abort_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'", "NEW.updated_at >= OLD.updated_at", "IS DISTINCT FROM",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(migration, required) {
			t.Fatalf("migration transition guard missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	down, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../docs/onboarding-path-admission-rollback.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, required := range []string{"ACCESS EXCLUSIVE", "cannot roll back", "IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_onboarding_path_admission)"} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(down), required) {
			t.Fatalf("down migration missing %q", required)
		}
	}
}

func TestMigrationDiscoveryHasOneForwardOnly025AndSkipsAppleDouble(t *testing.T) {
	files, err := filepath.Glob("../../../../db/migrations/*.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	seen025 := 0
	for _, file := range files {
		base := filepath.Base(file)
		if strings.HasPrefix(base, "._") {
			// Taskfile's shell glob does not expand dot-files. Keep the check
			// explicit because macOS worktrees contain AppleDouble sidecars.
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(base, "025_") {
			seen025++
			if base != "025_student_onboarding_path_admission.sql" {
				t.Fatalf("migration runner would execute a non-forward 025 file: %s", base)
			}
		}
	}
	if seen025 != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("wanted exactly one forward migration 025, got %d", seen025)
	}
}

func TestOnboardingPathAdmissionRepositoryUsesTheSharedPathLock(t *testing.T) {
	contents, err := os.ReadFile("onboarding_path_admission_repo_pg.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	source := string(contents)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"lockStudentAdmissionFence(ctx, tx, student)", "SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_learning_path WHERE student_id=$1 AND status='ACTIVE')",
		"getAdmissionOperation(ctx, tx", "putAdmissionOperation(ctx, tx", "FOR UPDATE", "student_learning_path_revision",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(source, required) {
			t.Fatalf("repository missing %q", required)
		}
	}
}
